paragraphs: I'm applying for the Private Markets Deal Coordinator role on the Co-Investments team. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli in New York, and before school I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. NB's co-investment program is one of the largest in private markets, and I'd like to learn the business from the seat that keeps each deal moving.

At Thomson Reuters I managed financial operations and cash flow analysis, overseeing 80%+ of total inflows, and used automation to cut the cash conversion cycle by 20%. At Lenovo I built forecasts and scenario models that improved capital efficiency by 15%. In my MBA coursework I built a DCF and an LBO model for J.M. Smucker, so I can follow the numbers behind a deal.
Tracking timelines, keeping documents and data accurate and working across investment, legal and operations teams is work I've done well. I'd welcome the chance to talk.
